# PodSync

> A lean, native-feeling macOS podcast client for Apple Silicon. Syncs with gpodder.net, works fully offline, and detects and skips ads on-device. Nothing leaves your Mac.

PodSync is a native Mac app built for Apple Silicon only (no Intel build), with a small install size and low idle resource use. SQLite is the local source of truth; gpodder.net is a sync target the app reconciles subscriptions and play state with when online, not a required backend. Ad detection and episode transcription run on-device by default using a local model; a remote OpenAI-compatible API can be used instead. Free during the alpha/beta testing period.
